primary_responsibility: Manages the shopping cart lifecycle, including item quantity adjustments, stock validation, price monitoring, and the transition to the checkout process.

functional_group_candidates.name: Shopping Cart Management
functional_group_candidates.user_goal: Manage items intended for purchase and prepare for checkout
business_rules: Minimum item quantity is 1; quantities less than 1 trigger item removal
Items must be in stock to proceed to checkout
Price consistency must be validated before checkout (current price must match added price)
User must be authenticated to initiate checkout
Cart must contain items to enable checkout

functional_group_candidates.name: Checkout Initiation
functional_group_candidates.user_goal: Transition from shopping cart to a formal order payment process
business_rules: Checkout requires valid cart items and subtotal/tax/shipping calculations
Checkout initiation triggers event tracking for analytics
Successful initiation redirects user to a unique checkout session URL
